forward_scope: forward only, fresh state per call; full cell projections plus state/scan; allocation and synchronization included

checkpoint.storage_scope: Component allocations, not measured peak or CUDA caching-allocator reservation. Capture scratch and base/replay state remain O(S); retained logs use at most twice the largest store event count per store plus per-token routing records.

residual_risks: Head scaling: scoring batches heads across the launch grid, but each query still pads 15 unused MMA rows; recurrent metadata work, dense base-state allocation and memory traffic scale with heads. There is no shared multi-query GEMM.

Checkpoint time: changed-bit capture scans vector spills, stages proposed values, packs ordered groups, synchronizes to size/compact logs, clones replay state and rebases addresses. A faster forward exposes these costs.
Base/replay state, dense death diagnostics and transient capture staging remain O(S). Log storage independence does not assert total training memory independence.

Retained journal capacity is at most twice the largest store event count per store; unequal store activity can waste a factor of stores. Capture reservation bounds potential live events and is released after compaction.
Learning was not rerun in part 6; MQAR and ladder results remain historical part 5 measurements.
